decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason (Condition 3)
The details submitted pursuant to condition 3 (Phasing) of planning permission 00248/D6-7/P1 dated 07.09.07 for 'One nine storey and one twelve storey buildings for business use (Use class B1) associated plant, standby generators and compactors, landscaping, servicing and access arrangements, together with the reconfiguration of the approved car parking layout', are satisfactory.
Reason (Conditions 8 and 20)
The details submitted pursuant to conditions 8 and 20 (Mud, dust and illumination) of planning permission 00248/D6-7/P1 dated 07.09.07 for 'One nine storey and one twelve storey buildings for business use (Use class B1) associated plant, standby generators and compactors, landscaping, servicing and access arrangements, together with the reconfiguration of the approved car parking layout', are considered to meet the requirements of the condition and relevant policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV-P.1.7 (Light Pollution) and ENV-P.1.6 (Air Pollution) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
description: Details of phasing; mud, dust and external illumination; submitted pursuant to conditions 3, 8, and 20 of permission 00248/D6-7/P1 dated 07.09.07 for 'One nine storey and one twelve storey buildings for business use (Use class B1) associated plant, standby generators and compactors, landscaping, servicing and access arrangements, together with the reconfiguration of the approved car parking layout'.
